summaries.title: Scaling Up to Excellence: Practicing Model Scaling for Photo-Realistic Image Restoration In the Wild
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」痛点，作者围绕 **Scaling Up to Excellence** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）。核心论点主张：We introduce SUPIR (Scaling-UP Image Restoration), a groundbreaking image restoration method that harnesses generative prior and the power of model scaling up。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We collect a dataset comprising 20 million high-resolution, high-quality images for model training, each enriched with descriptive text annotations。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments demonstrate SUPIR's exceptional restoration effects and its novel capacity to manipulate restoration through textual prompts）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 78 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: MambaByte: Token-free Selective State Space Model
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **MambaByte** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖状态空间模型（State Space Model (SSM)）。核心论点主张：Operating on bytes, however, results in significantly longer sequences, and standard autoregressive Transformers scale poorly in such settings。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用线性复杂度递归状态/注意力融合架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We experiment with MambaByte, a token-free adaptation of the Mamba state space model, trained autoregressively on byte sequences。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We also find MambaByte to be competitive with and even outperform state-of-the-art subword Transformers）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 60 赞），本工作为突破 **状态空间与线性注意力 (SSM/Mamba)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: BootPIG: Bootstrapping Zero-shot Personalized Image Generation Capabilities in Pretrained Diffusion Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **BootPIG** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：We propose a novel architecture (BootPIG) that allows a user to provide reference images of an object in order to guide the appearance of a concept in the generated images。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Experiments on the DreamBooth dataset demonstrate that BootPIG outperforms existing zero-shot methods while being comparable with test-time finetuning approaches。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments on the DreamBooth dataset demonstrate that BootPIG outperforms existing zero-shot methods while being comparable with test-time finetuning approaches）。
